summary: Replace timezone typing with selection-only dropdowns and remove the unwanted keyboard-test field. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Operators now select an area and timezone without typing; keyboard-test field removed.

api.reason: Native widgets emit the existing canonical timezone in protected local installer configuration; no API contract changes.

state.reason: Installer presentation and input handling only; the installed host gains no new durable setting and the Controller stores nothing.

verification.method: Compiled checks and native VM walkthrough; results and limits in QA report.
